description: Screens 1 to 20 wallet addresses against the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list (crypto addresses) and the ScamSniffer scam and drainer blacklist, in one call at one price. Returns block or clear per address with the reason, plus list sizes and freshness. Address-level, so it works for Base, Arc, Ethereum and any EVM chain. Useful before sending a payment, paying an x402 seller, accepting funds, or approving a spender. Read-only. Not charged for invalid addresses. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

addresses.description: 1 to 20 wallet 0x addresses (an array, or one comma-separated string).

name: wallet_sanctions_check
title: Wallet screening: is this address on the OFAC sanctions list or a known scam/drainer list?
